text:
A simple notice, just now
An efficient watch is easier with a plan
Travelers, please review your pet travel papers and kennel setup before you head to the airport.
Pet check-in at the Companion Animal Travel Desk can move fast, but only when carriers are secure, labels are clear, and the pet is calm enough for a safe handoff. The senior coordinator is keeping daily service choices on track, and the safety coordinator is checking for risks, small fixes, and any care needs that may affect the trip.

If you are bringing a pet through Aurelia Skyways, stay close to your travel papers and listen for desk guidance right away. Daisy or another pet may need a quick comfort pause, a fresh water check, or a look at the carrier latch before acceptance. Please keep collars, leashes, and support items ready in your carry-on so the process does not stall.

If anything looks off, report it at once and do not wait until the last minute. Come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the next step, and we will help you move ahead safely.
